verdicts.reason: A scatters the elements: the SOLSTICE logo shrinks to a speck beside the CTA, the sale banner floats on its own over the planet, the CTA is pushed to the bottom-left and the lower right is dead space. B keeps the hierarchy and a clear reading order, but the legal line has been blown up to subhead size, jammed between the headline and CTA with no gap, and leaves 'Co., 2026.' as an orphan.

A's two-column split is reasonable, but the 'Longest Day Sale' banner shrinks to an unreadable sliver stuck in the bottom-right corner, and the enlarged legal copy runs into the background dots. B has a good top-to-bottom stack, but the legal text is oversized and crammed against the headline and CTA, with an orphaned last line.

A keeps a clear centred stack, with logo and banner at the top, then product, headline and CTA, but the legal text is oversized and cramped against the headline and CTA. B's headline sits over the planet; the product is small and isolated on the left with dead space around it; the banner is wedged between the legal text and CTA; and the logo drifts down to the bottom-centre.

A breaks the hierarchy: the CTA is a tiny, near-illegible pill in the bottom-right corner, and the sale banner is microscopic and lost on the planet, so the call to action is buried. B has a clear headline-to-CTA flow with a prominent button; its only flaw is the oversized, crammed legal line with an orphan.
